journal.restless.form.whole: Takes it whole: an iron ingot, glowstone, holy water, a mirror.
journal.restless.form.bit: Takes a bit: an iron nugget, glowstone dust, salt, a glass pane.
journal.restless.form.crafted: Takes it crafted: an iron chain, a lantern, a bell, a spyglass.
journal.restless.bestiary.poltergeist: Loud and restless. Doors, chests, things moving on their own. Hardly dangerous at first.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade: Quiet. Puts out lights, whispers, wears you down. Gets crueler over time.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade.name: Shade
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom: Wants to pass for a living person: a stranger far off, a name that isn't there. Rarely hurts anyone.
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom.name: Phantom
journal.restless.bestiary.nix: Stays near water. Holds swimmers under, calls you toward the shore, breaks boats.
journal.restless.bestiary.nix.name: Nix
journal.restless.bestiary.mimic: Fakes things: blocks that aren't there, strangers, animals that vanish.
journal.restless.bestiary.mimic.name: Mimic
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith: Hunts in the dark. Puts your light out first, then comes closer.
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith.name: Wraith
journal.restless.bestiary.mara: Sits on sleepers. Worse at night, worst of all in a bed.
journal.restless.bestiary.mara.name: Mara
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee: Mostly a voice. Makes noise and barely touches anything.
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee.name: Banshee
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant: Out for revenge. Hurts you, sends animals after you, remembers every kill.
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant.name: Revenant
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one: Wanders. Shapes, footsteps, strangers. Follows you underground.
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one.name: Lost one
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi: Lives in a house. Doors, belongings, noises around the place. Mostly harmless.
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi.name: Domovoi
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder: Stays in one place and takes whatever you leave lying there.
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder.name: Hoarder
journal.restless.bestiary.demon: Stays in one place and is dangerous: hits you, makes you sick, sends animals.
journal.restless.bestiary.demon.name: Demon
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster: Stays in one place and plays tricks: changes blocks and items, shows you things that aren't there.
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster.name: Trickster
journal.restless.guide.start.title: Read this first
journal.restless.guide.start.1: The dead here don't rest. Some attach themselves to a living person and follow them around. Others stay in one place.
journal.restless.guide.start.2: They start out weak and get stronger the longer they're left alone. I learned that the hard way. Some pages are blank because I never worked those out.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.title: Signs
journal.restless.guide.haunted.1: Doors slam on their own, torches go out, steps sound where nobody is walking. That's a spirit, and it won't stop by itself.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.2: A spirit candle leans toward whoever the spirit goes for next, and burns blue just before. A spirit compass points at the nearest one. A closed ring of salt keeps them out. I tested it.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.3: Only tools tell you which one it is: ash for prints, a camera obscura for photos, a spirit box, an ouija board. Each one shows only part of it.
journal.restless.guide.clues.title: Telling them apart
journal.restless.guide.clues.1: Every spirit has its own habits, and one clue shows only one of them. I never decided until I had a few.
journal.restless.guide.clues.2: Photos and ash prints are always true. The spirit box and the board sometimes lie.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.title: The altar
journal.restless.guide.weakness.1: Every spirit has a nature, one of four: iron, glowstone, holy water or mirror. Nearly all its habits come from it, and exactly one is foreign. Two different habits of one nature name it.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.2: Iron: reaches for things, slams doors, goes through chests. Glowstone: eats light, chills the air, walks at night, dwells in the dark. Holy water: takes revenge, walks in the rain, calls from the deep, forgives nothing. Mirror: whispers, feeds on noise, steals sleep, lies.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.3: Ash does not lie. A paw means iron, a drag mark glowstone, a hoof holy water, a bare foot mirror. A foreign habit leaves a foreign print, so I go by the print I see most.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.4: A nature is not enough: the spirit does not take every item of it. The bestiary card, once I have a photo, says which: whole, a bit, or crafted. I built an altar, lit four candles, closed a ring of salt and laid the right thing down. A form it does not take, it puts up with, but the ritual drags on.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.5: It fights back: snuffs the candles and hits, and I relit them. The wrong nature costs more: every candle goes out, the spirit rages, hides for a day and turns the altar away, and it comes of age sooner.
journal.restless.guide.graves.title: Graves
journal.restless.guide.graves.1: Every spirit used to be someone. The grave turned up a few hundred blocks from home, and the stone says who they were and what they lost.
journal.restless.guide.graves.2: Once I brought that back, they rested. It worked better than any ritual. When my head was going, the spirit box told me where the bones were.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.title: Your head
journal.restless.guide.sanity.1: Darkness, cursed ground and every scare wore me down. Light, food, sleep and salt brought me back.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.2: The worse shape I was in, the more the spirit box picked up.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.title: Left alone
journal.restless.guide.evolution.1: A spirit left alone long enough turns into something worse, and it doesn't turn back. The ground around some of them goes grey.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.2: Once it's banished or at rest, the ground recovers.
journal.restless.guide.essence.title: Essence
journal.restless.guide.essence.1: Some spirits leave essence behind. A ritual gave one. A grave put right gave more.
journal.restless.guide.essence.2: Every spirit leaves its own kind, and charms can be made from it: poltergeist essence pulls dropped items in, shade essence lets you see in the dark. Craft the rest with one common thing each; the name of the charm says whose it is.
restless.relighting.title: Relighting
restless.relighting.description: Right-click the placed light with flint and steel or a lit torch. Flint and steel loses 1 durability; torches are not consumed. Cannot ignite underwater.
message.restless.holy_water_cloudy: The water has gone cloudy. It is useless until dawn.
trait.restless.restless_hands.hint: it reaches for things left lying around
trait.restless.cold_touch.hint: it chills the air around you
trait.restless.meddler.hint: it meddles with the world around you
trait.restless.chest_watcher.hint: it guards what is in chests

restless.configuration.title: Restless
message.restless.banished_more: The %s is gone, and leaves %s essences.
message.restless.effigy_refused: Nothing could answer the call now.
message.restless.effigy_cold: The effigy burns down, and nothing answers.
journal.restless.met.poltergeist: Met: in woodland mansions and trail ruins. An effigy stuffed with its essence calls one.
journal.restless.met.shade: Met: it may be there from the start. No deed calls it; an effigy stuffed with its essence does.
journal.restless.met.nix: Met: at shipwrecks and ocean ruins. An effigy by the water stuffed with its essence calls one.
journal.restless.met.phantom: Met: it may be there from the start. No deed calls it; an effigy stuffed with its essence does.
journal.restless.met.mimic: Met: it may be there from the start. No deed calls it; an effigy stuffed with its essence does.
journal.restless.met.wraith: Met: it may be there from the start. No deed calls it; an effigy stuffed with its essence does.
journal.restless.met.mara: Met: it may be there from the start. No deed calls it; an effigy stuffed with its essence does.
journal.restless.met.banshee: Met: when a villager or a pet dies before my eyes, or a pet is lost. An effigy stuffed with its essence calls one.
journal.restless.met.revenant: Met: after a slaughter of animals and villagers, or the killing of my own pet. An effigy stuffed with its essence calls one.
journal.restless.met.lost_one: Met: after dying far from home, or two days awake. An effigy stuffed with its essence calls one.
journal.restless.met.domovoi: Met: in villages, rarely. An effigy stuffed with its essence calls one.
journal.restless.met.hoarder: Met: in igloos and pyramids. An effigy stuffed with its essence calls one.
journal.restless.met.demon: Met: at ruined portals, ancient cities, bastions and fortresses. An effigy stuffed with its essence calls one.
journal.restless.met.trickster: Met: at swamp huts. An effigy stuffed with its essence calls one.
message.restless.still_elsewhere: The water is still, and nothing answers here.
message.restless.still_storm: The water calls up a storm.
message.restless.draught_drunk: The draught is still in you.
message.restless.draught_taken: You will sleep, and nothing will wake you.
message.restless.wayfinder_nowhere: The ash finds nowhere to lead.
message.restless.wayfinder_death: The ash leads you to where you fell.
message.restless.feather_nothing: The feather finds nothing unopened near.
message.restless.feather_done: No unopened chest is left in reach.
message.restless.dust_traded: This one has traded, and its fortune is set.
message.restless.oil_no_weapon: Hold a weapon in the other hand.
message.restless.contract_signed: This already stands past its peak.
message.restless.contract_no_peak: Nothing on it stands at its highest level.
message.restless.porridge_open: A bowl is left only in a shut, roofed room.
message.restless.porridge_served: A bowl already serves this room.
message.restless.knot_tied: A knot is tied here already.
message.restless.mark_many: You can keep no more marks.
message.restless.clay_unseen: The clay can take no look from that.
message.restless.clay_pressed: The clay takes the look of %s.
message.restless.mask_framed: The blow lands, and the mask holds: something near turns on the struck one.
message.restless.walk_off: The night lets go of you.
message.restless.debt_paid: The debt is paid in blood.
message.restless.tide_dry: There is no tide to call here.
message.restless.truth_spent: The eye keeps this reading honest.
message.restless.hearth_open: A dream like this needs a shut, roofed room.
message.restless.ferried: You fade, and the water does not take you.
message.restless.hollow_robbed: A hollow is lighter than it was.
message.restless.reliquary_added: The %s essence settles into the reliquary.
message.restless.reliquary_unnamed: You have not named what this came from. Photograph its kind first.
message.restless.reliquary_duplicate: The reliquary already holds one of those.
message.restless.bell_sneak: Crouch, and hold, to ring it.
message.restless.bell_silent: The bell has nothing to give back.
message.restless.bell_rung: The bell rings, and the dead remember you.
journal.restless.note.laid: %s, a %s, was laid to rest at the Requiem.
message.restless.requiem_not_full: The reliquary is not full: it needs one essence of every kind.
message.restless.requiem_released: You are already let go. Ring the bell if you want to go back.
message.restless.requiem_wary: The dead are still angry about the last Requiem. The altar will not answer yet.
message.restless.requiem_busy: A Requiem is already being sung here.
message.restless.requiem_incomplete: The Requiem needs a closed salt ring, %s lit candles around the altar and a bell within %s blocks.
message.restless.requiem_begins: You begin to sing the Requiem. Keep the candles lit.
message.restless.requiem_missed: %s was not answered. A candle goes out.
message.restless.requiem_aborted: The Requiem is broken off. Nothing is lost.
message.restless.requiem_failed: The Requiem fails. The essence (%s) is lost, the dead are angrier, and the altar will not answer for three days.
message.restless.requiem_bargain: A voice offers a bargain: be spared this movement for the price of %3$s candles. %1$s or %2$s?
message.restless.requiem_taken: The bargain is struck. The movement is skipped, and candles go out.
message.restless.requiem_refused: You refuse. The voice goes quiet.
message.restless.requiem_no_bargain: No one is offering you anything.
requiem.restless.cue.shade: The light dies around the altar. Keep at least 4 lights burning.
requiem.restless.cue.poltergeist: Your things fly from your pockets. Pick them all up again.
requiem.restless.cue.nix: Water rises in the circle. Do not drown, and keep the altar dry.
requiem.restless.cue.phantom: Strangers stand outside the ring. Do not look at them.
requiem.restless.cue.mimic: Two more altars have risen. Lay holy water on the true one.
requiem.restless.cue.wraith: Darkness, and blows from nowhere. Stay above three hearts, and keep to the light.
requiem.restless.cue.mara: A heavy sleep falls. Only a steady mind wakes.
requiem.restless.cue.banshee: A wail. Ring the bell when the silence comes.
requiem.restless.cue.revenant: The things you killed rise. Kill them all.
requiem.restless.cue.lost_one: You are lost. Find your way back into the ring in time.
requiem.restless.cue.domovoi: Doors slam open. Close every door near the altar.
requiem.restless.cue.hoarder: Your offering is stolen. It lies in one of the chests.
requiem.restless.cue.trickster: Candles go out and change places. Relight what was lit, and leave the false ones.
journal.restless.guide.requiem.title: Requiem
journal.restless.guide.requiem.1: I carried one essence of every kind to the altar and sang them out. Their business was finished, and so, in the only way that counted, was mine.
journal.restless.guide.requiem.2: Nothing is born on me now, and nothing acts on me. The reliquary became a bell. If I miss them, I can crouch and ring it, and three of them will come back.
advancements.restless.requiem.title: Requiem
advancements.restless.requiem.descriptio: Sing every spirit out, and be let go
requiem.restless.title: Requiem
requiem.restless.poem.1: They came to you in the dark, each asking for one small thing:
requiem.restless.poem.2: a light, a name, a door, a hand to hold.
requiem.restless.poem.3: You learned their faces by what they took from you,
requiem.restless.poem.4: and their names by what they left behind.
requiem.restless.poem.6: Salt on the sill. A candle that would not stay lit.
requiem.restless.poem.7: Fourteen kinds of grief in one quiet box,
requiem.restless.poem.9: You sang it aloud, and it was not a spell.
requiem.restless.poem.11: Now the stones stand and the names are read.
requiem.restless.poem.12: The cold goes out of the rooms; the rooms are only rooms.
requiem.restless.poem.13: Nobody walks behind you. Nobody waits in the dark.
requiem.restless.poem.15: Go home. The night is only night.
item.restless.salt.tip: Place it as a ring: no spirit's event runs on whoever stands inside.
item.restless.ash.tip: Place it: spirits leave prints that show one trait. Never lies.
item.restless.spirit_candle.tip: Hold it: the flame leans to the spirit that acts next.
item.restless.spirit_compass.tip: Hold it: the needle points at the nearest spirit.
item.restless.camera_obscura.tip: Use it: a photo shows the type of a spirit nearby.
item.restless.photo.tip: Shows the type of a spirit. Never lies.
item.restless.spirit_box.tip: Place it and speak: it answers with a word. May lie.
item.restless.ouija_board.tip: Place it and use it: it spells out a trait. May lie.
item.restless.door_charm.tip: Stick to a block: stops door events within 8 blocks. Breaks after 5.
item.restless.dreamcatcher.tip: Hang it: no event runs on you asleep within 5 blocks.
item.restless.hallowed_lantern.tip: No spirit's event runs on you within 6 blocks.
item.restless.scarecrow.tip: Stops any event within 16 blocks. Breaks after 10.
item.restless.effigy.tip: Stuff with an essence and light it to call that spirit.
item.restless.altar.tip: Banish spirits here: offer inside a salt ring among lit candles.
item.restless.holy_water.tip: Altar offering of the holy water nature.
item.restless.mirror.tip: Altar offering of the mirror nature.
item.restless.essence.tip: A banished spirit's remains. Craft it into charms, consumables and relics.
item.restless.telekinesis_amulet.tip: Off hand: pulls dropped items and experience to you.
item.restless.dark_eye.tip: Off hand: see in the dark; living things and spirits show.
item.restless.drowned_stone.tip: Off hand: breathe and swim freely in water; slow on land.
item.restless.borrowed_face.tip: Use: hostile mobs take you for their own for 25 seconds.
item.restless.phantom_double.tip: Use: a copy of you draws hostile mobs for 8 seconds.
item.restless.wraith_shroud.tip: Use: blows pass through you for 5 seconds.
item.restless.borrowed_dream.tip: Use: sanity back to full. Angers your spirits. Once a day.
item.restless.death_wail.tip: Carried: below 3 hearts it throws hostile mobs back. Once a day.
item.restless.grudge.tip: Off hand: stores damage you take; your next blow adds half.
item.restless.lost_step.tip: Use: slip up to 8 blocks ahead, through thin walls.
item.restless.house_key.tip: Off hand, in a shut roofed room: spirits' events do not run.
item.restless.stash.tip: Use: stores one stack. In your inventory it survives your death.
item.restless.bargain.tip: Use: full health and strong effects, then two hearts fewer.
item.restless.trickster_coin.tip: Use: wager your next kill; its drops double or are lost.
item.restless.fetch_path.tip: The Lost Step, leaving a copy of you behind.
item.restless.changeling_mask.tip: The Borrowed Face; your first blow frames the mob you hit.
item.restless.nightwalk_shroud.tip: Toggle: in dim light hostile mobs lose you; you pass through mobs.
item.restless.blood_debt.tip: The Grudge, uncapped; a killing blow heals you.
item.restless.requital_wail.tip: The Death Wail; mobs it throws back take more damage.
item.restless.tidecaller.tip: The Drowned Stone, with a dash in water and rain.
item.restless.magpies_hook.tip: The Amulet, near items only. Sneak-use on a container to link it.
item.restless.truthseers_eye.tip: The Dark Eye. Off hand: the next reading cannot lie. Once a day.
item.restless.hearth_dream.tip: Use in a shut roofed room: sanity to full, no anger. Once a day.
item.restless.keepers_key.tip: The House Key, bound to one room, where it never wears.
item.restless.grave_satchel.tip: The Stash for three stacks. Rests three days after your death.
item.restless.devils_coin.tip: The Trickster's Coin; wagers every kill for 30 seconds.
item.restless.twins_mirror.tip: The Phantom Double, standing where you look.
item.restless.black_bargain.tip: The Bargain with longer fury; costs sanity, not hearts.
item.restless.still_water.tip: Drink: clears the weather for a day. Sneaking: a storm.
item.restless.dreamless_draught.tip: Drink before bed: sleep near monsters and wake calmer.
item.restless.wayfinders_ash.tip: Use: footprints lead to where you died. Sneaking: to your spawn.
item.restless.magpie_feather.tip: Use: a stream of light leads to the nearest unopened chest.
item.restless.changeling_dust.tip: Use on a block to swap it for kin, or on a villager to redo trades.
item.restless.bloodied_rag.tip: Throw: mobs of that type nearby go for it.
item.restless.wraith_oil.tip: Use with a weapon in the other hand: 30 harder blows in the dark.
item.restless.infernal_contract.tip: Use with an enchanted item in the other hand: one enchantment goes a level higher.
item.restless.restless_knot.tip: Tie to a container: it takes in dropped items nearby for 10 minutes.
item.restless.dusk_salt.tip: Scatter: no hostile mob spawns nearby for a day.
item.restless.sighting_mark.tip: Place: a pale figure glows through walls for three days.
item.restless.mimic_clay.tip: Press on a block to take its look, then set it down.
item.restless.omen_candle.tip: Light it: harmful events nearby are announced 5 seconds ahead.
item.restless.domovois_porridge.tip: Set in a shut roofed room: crops and animals grow faster for a day.
item.restless.hoarders_hollow.tip: A chest shared by all your hollows. Disguise it with mimic clay.
item.restless.reliquary.tip: Holds one essence of every type, for the Requiem.
item.restless.requiem_bell.tip: Sneak and ring it for 5 seconds to take back your release.
item.restless.ferrymans_coin.tip: Off hand: a killing blow fades you instead. Rests 3 days.
item.restless.exorcists_censer.tip: Off hand at the altar: shorter ritual, candles stay lit, one more essence.
item.restless.hollow_lantern.tip: Wards 24 blocks and writes a clue for every event it stops.
item.restless.maras_cradle.tip: A bed: all sanity back, and the night does not pass.
item.restless.gravestone.tip: Use to read. Give it what the spirit wants to lay it to rest.
item.restless.journal.tip: Records everything you learn about spirits.
